title: A checked isomorphism between two presentations of F_25

source.citation: Ludovic Brieulle, Luca De Feo, Javad Doliskani, Jean-Pierre Flori, and Eric Schost, Computing isomorphisms and embeddings of finite fields, arXiv:1705.01221

translation.notes: The paper's characteristic-7 degree-237 benchmark is reduced to a hand-checkable degree-2 case with the same presentation-isomorphism contract. The case distinguishes Noether's deterministic choice from mathematical uniqueness by exhibiting its Frobenius-conjugate alternative. The program and prose are original and no source code is redistributed.
